description: Where does the number of UNION arms stop being accepted, and at which phase? Only the count varies (n = 2, 16, 32, 33, 50, 51, 64) over the one-row table ONE: n arms joined by UNION (rows read), and the same n arms joined by UNION ALL inside SELECT Count(*) AS n FROM (...). Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
